findings.claim: The learning/control support is the score-clock window [0.0,0.5] with 50 observed score nodes at 0.01 spacing; the reward geometry is a fixed endpoint pointcloud scalar (delta_A=1, frozen temperatures, teacher_blend=0), so any temporal lane may only vary registered dose_factors.

Across the full observed window, per-feature coordinate trends are dominated by sign reversals and strong sign conflicts rather than a stable monotone drift: e.g. landmark_00_local_dy has first_rate_z=-72.4 and last_rate_z=+5.5 with 6 sign changes and 4 strong conflicts, and landmark_00_local_dx has first_rate_z=-17.5 and last_rate_z=+8.1 with 6 sign changes and 9 strong conflicts.

Several features show large early-window rate magnitudes that decay or reverse by the end of the window (landmark_01_local_dy first_rate_z=-42.8, last_rate_z=+5.0; landmark_01_local_dz first_rate_z=-58.5, last_rate_z=+8.8), consistent with a changing contrast rather than a stationary target across the whole window.

No polynomial representation is accepted for any queried feature (polynomial_accepted=false, extrapolation_allowed=false), so the observed-node linear representation is the only supported description and no extrapolation beyond the observed nodes is licensed.

The registered temporal recipes are predeclared interventions (knots_origin states 'predeclared intervention; not a discovered biological stage') with equal sum(dt*w) ratio budgets; the observed coordinate evidence does not by itself identify any of these phases as a discovered stage boundary.

hypotheses.direction: weaker early control, unchanged or stronger late control
hypotheses.falsifier: first_rate_z magnitudes do not decrease, or late-window rate magnitudes increase by a comparable amount, indicating the change is a total-displacement shift rather than a timing effect.
hypotheses.observable: per-feature first_rate_z and last_rate_z on the observed score nodes
hypotheses.statement: If early-window guidance dose is reduced relative to later nodes while the total ratio budget is preserved, then the early-window coordinate rate magnitudes (e.g. landmark_00_local_dy, landmark_01_local_dy, landmark_01_local_dz) should shrink toward zero without a compensating increase in late-window rate magnitude.

hypotheses.falsifier: sign_changes or strong_sign_conflicts are dominated by a single batch, indicating clone dependence rather than a reproducible temporal contrast.
hypotheses.observable: sign_changes and strong_sign_conflicts per feature across independent batches
hypotheses.statement: If the observed sign reversals in landmark_00_local_dx and landmark_00_local_dy reflect a genuine time-varying contrast rather than clone-dependent noise, then the same sign pattern should persist across independent batches at the same score nodes.

limitations: temporal_profiles_available is false; no per-node temporal profile table was delivered, so whole-window temporal claims rest on the continuous_trends summary rows only.
Unqueried features and unqueried score nodes are not evidence of absence; only the 24 continuous_trends rows returned here were inspected.
Descendant final quality and decoded final affinity are not observed in this role input, so no claim is made that any temporal dose improves final affinity.
The registered recipes are predeclared interventions; no discovered stage boundary is asserted.
The coordinate features are untyped proxies; no energy or chemical-interaction interpretation is attached.
